detail: This commit adds the phase 1 process capsule: an LD_PRELOAD boundary that records an arbitrary native program's external reads and serves them back under replay, wired to the existing four-way verdict vocabulary. It corrects no shipped runtime defect; it is a new capability whose central bet was deliberately measured rather than assumed, and the retained MEASUREMENT.md records where the boundary succeeds, where it fails closed, and what stays unmeasured.
